author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: New runOutDate attribute on each tank (yyyy-MM-dd: today plus the days remaining), also shown on the tile. lowFuel is now declared as a true/false enum, so rules can pick its value, and it is sent after the other readings, so a rule it triggers sees the current level and run-out date. The hourly check runs in the background instead of holding the hub. A rejected Client ID or Secret is now reported as such, not as an API outage. Requires Hubitat 2.2.9+.
